title: Don't Just Impute, Detect: Task-Aware Diffusion Pipelines for Edge Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.40732v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) edge pipelines routinely lose contiguous blocks of multi-sensor data to network dropouts and hardware faults. The standard remedy is a disjointed "impute-then-detect" pipeline whose imputer is trained only for Mean Squared Error (MSE). Such an imputer fills a missing block with the most probable normal pattern: a partially observed anomaly is smoothed back toward normality, and boundary artifacts on normal data raise false alarms. We call this imputation bias and propose the Task-Aware Diffusion Refiner (TADR), a conditional diffusion refiner trained against the loss landscape of a frozen downstream detector. Because back-propagating through the sampling trajectory is intractable, the task-aware terms act on the one-step clean-window estimate that the noise prediction already yields, so training costs no more than plain diffusion training. translated_abstract: 工业物联网（IIoT）边缘流水线经常因网络中断和硬件故障而丢失连续的多传感器数据块。标准的解决方案是割裂的“先插补后检测”流水线，其中的插补器仅针对均方误差（MSE）进行训练。这样的插补器会用最可能的正常模式来填充缺失的数据块：部分观测到的异常会被平滑回正常状态，而正常数据上的边界伪影则会引发误报。我们将这一现象称为插补偏差，并提出任务感知扩散精炼器，这是一种针对冻结的下游检测器的损失景观进行训练的条件扩散精炼器。由于通过采样轨迹进行反向传播是不可行的，任务感知项作用于噪声预测已经产生的单步干净窗口估计，因此其训练成本不超过普通的扩散训练。在五个随机种子下进行严格的点到点评估，在……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出TADR任务感知扩散精炼器，通过在冻结下游检测器的损失景观上训练扩散模型来克服“插补偏差”，避免异常被平滑掩盖和正常数据被误报，且训练成本与普通扩散训练相当。
en_tdlr: Proposes TADR, a task-aware diffusion refiner trained against a frozen downstream detector's loss landscape to overcome "imputation bias," preventing anomalies from being smoothed away while matching the training cost of standard diffusion.
